name: # som-b41-struggle (build 41, docs/re-xr-pipeline.md 180): the ring's node of a struggle's UI data (SOMVR_STRUGGLE_RULE=b41: an aim's outline at it, every class's cue there). Windows-only K_ENTRY sites (somvr_struggle_game.c, outside the SITES blocks): called, never patched; on the game thread from the input tick with the struggle object just read and its vtable one of the five (STG_VT_*)
STG_UI_XF
notes: = Linux FUN_00e114f0 (pairs.tsv nbr): the struggle widget's world anchor - FUN_1405ab600(*(s+0x78)) the UI data, FUN_1405ab090 its node name, FUN_1405aaf70 its ECombatStruggleUIPositionType (0 = none: the identity), the character *(s+0x38) or *(s+0x70) by (type == 1) == (*(s+0xa4) != 0), its vf +0x20, then GetNodeIndex (vf +0x1f8; Linux +0x1f0) and the node's world transform (vf +0x228, world 1; Linux +0x220) into out: LTRigidTransform pos xyz + rot xyzw (28 bytes; w 1.0 by default). ABI: Windows (struggle rcx, out rdx) = the C signature (uintptr_t s, float *out); Linux (out rdi, s rsi: the Itanium member function's hidden return first) - not used there (the native Linux build is retired). Callers: the five classes' updates and starts (0x1405ac134, 0x1405accb6 Dir, 0x1405ae152, 0x1405ae75a, 0x1405af12b PressCount, 0x1405af63f Hold, 0x1405af96e Aim)
